description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Head of PDP-Connect/data-connect main as of 2026-09-02 ('chore(deps): bump the cargo group in /src-tauri with 5 updates', #39), verified via `gh api repos/PDP-Connect/data-connect/branches/main` at pin time. Supersedes the prior 0bc3f8c5b4 pin (PR #34, 2026-08-31): pin-freshness — data-connect had gone red because main's packages/collector-runtime and packages/connector-protocol sources had moved past that pin (unrelated to the PDPP #238/data-connect #36 cutover this same repin PR otherwise handles). This repo's own vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz and vendor/pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz were re-packed from this SHA in the same change that moved this pin (npm run build + npm pack from inside the data-connect workspace, per packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/README.md; verified locally the fresh repack's content differs from the prior committed tarballs, so this was a genuine re-vendor, not a no-op SHA move — see packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/SHA256SUMS). Source of truth for drift jobs (a) collector-definitions snapshot, (b) vendored connector sources, and the 0.0.1 half of (c) tarball digests.

data-connect-1-0-0.note: A SEPARATE, later data-connect SHA used ONLY by the 1.0.0 half of drift job (c) tarball-digests — deliberately NOT the same value as the `data-connect` pin above. pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS (see pdpp's vendor/README.md 'Current 1.0.0 release-boundary pins') records pdpp-collector-runtime-1.0.0.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-1.0.0.tgz packed from data-connect PR #36's tree — this is PR #36's merge commit into main ('Add local collection and release checks', merged 2026-09-02T07:53:00Z), superseding the prior 10f25a3cd6 pin which recorded the PR's pre-merge head commit. Confirmed via `git diff 10f25a3cd6..b70dda89a -- packages/collector-runtime packages/connector-protocol scripts/pin-collector-runtime-protocol-dependency.ts` (empty — the merge is a true two-parent merge of the reviewed branch, not a squash, so the packages this pin backs are byte-identical between the two commits; the merge additionally picked up an unrelated repo-wide SPDX-header sweep and other main-tip drift, none of it touching these paths) that the previously-vendored 1.0.0 tarballs still reconcile: no re-vendor needed, this is a SHA-reference-only update. This SHA is NOT used for jobs (a)/(b) or the 0.0.1 tarball repack: data-connect's local-collector/collector-runtime/connector-protocol sources changed materially between the `data-connect` pin above and this one (STREAM_EVIDENCE outcomes-partition wire change, capability-array validation, package-artifact receipts), so reusing this SHA for the shared `data-connect` pin would flip jobs (a)/(b) and the 0.0.1 repack from passing to failing — those still compare against data-connectors' and pdpp's committed 0.0.1 artifacts, which were packed from the OLDER `data-connect` pin and have not been repinned to 1.0.0 themselves. Revisit consolidating these two pins into one only once data-connectors' own packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/ moves off 0.0.1.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp main as of 2026-09-02 (PR #270, 'chore(vendor): resync pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz to data-connect main' — the pdpp-side half of this same tarball-digests fix). Supersedes the prior ab415be6c pin (PR #238's merge commit, 2026-09-02T08:20:22Z), which itself superseded de9e61690 (PR #238's pre-merge head on branch `waspflow/vendor-protocol-stream-evidence-0828` during the coordinated cutover this workflow's read-pins/pin-freshness jobs support; `branch` reverted to `main` once #238 landed). Verified no-op for drift job (d): PR #270 touches only vendor/ (`git diff` against ab415be6c shows only vendor/README.md, vendor/SHA256SUMS, vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz), not packages/reference-contract/src.
